native.title: Native Plants vs Invasives
native.subtitle: Why native Quebec plants matter for your garden
native.whyNativeText: Native plants evolved with local climate, soil, and wildlife. They require less water, fewer pesticides, and support pollinators and birds essential to Quebec ecosystems.
native.invasiveWarning: Invasive species spread aggressively, outcompete natives, and harm biodiversity. Never plant these in Quebec gardens.

winter.title: Winter Care Guide
winter.subtitle: Help your garden survive Quebec winters
winter.mulchText: Apply 10–15 cm of straw, shredded leaves, or bark mulch around perennial crowns after ground freezes. This insulates roots from freeze-thaw cycles.
winter.wrapText: Wrap young tree trunks with tree guards to prevent sunscald and rodent damage. Burlap-wrap sensitive evergreens against drying winter winds.
winter.snowText: Snow is an excellent insulator. Avoid shoveling snow away from garden beds. Gently brush heavy snow off branches to prevent breakage.
winter.waterText: Water deeply before ground freezes, especially evergreens. Well-hydrated plants survive winter desiccation better.
